title: WHEN-TO-WAKE ABI: code and protocol for Early Sedation De-escalation After Physiologic Stabilization and Day-7 Ventilator Liberation in Acute Brain Injury
description: Reproducible code, prespecified protocol and statistical analysis plan, aggregate outputs, and novelty-audit trail for a two-cohort sequential target-trial emulation of stability-triggered sedation de-escalation in mechanically ventilated adults with acute brain injury. Patient-level MIMIC-IV and eICU-CRD data are not included and must be obtained separately from PhysioNet under the applicable data-use requirements.
